mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collect_phase_steps (task_id, step_key, parent_step_key, step_order, step_node, title, status) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{stepKey}, #{parentStepKey}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepNode}, #{title}, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_step_key = VALUES(parent_step_key), step_order = VALUES(step_order), step_node = VALUES(step_node), title = VALUES(title), updated_at = NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE collect_phase_steps SET status = #{status}, message = #{message}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'running' THEN COALESCE(started_at, NOW(3)) ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'running' THEN NULL WHEN #{status} = 'pending' THEN NULL WHEN #{status} IN ('completed', 'failed', 'skipped') THEN COALESCE(finished_at, NOW(3)) ELSE finished_at END, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND step_key = #{stepKey}
